rules.en: Once you put the potions on the shelves, customers will automatically start visiting the Apothecary to purchase them.
The Apothecary will still operate while you are offline.
Special customer events will trigger after certain conditions are met. Managing those events will unlock new potions.
The earnings from each potion are affected by the current earning speed and the number of unlocked potions.
Apothecary earnings will temporarily be stored in the Deposit Box. The earnings limit is determined by the number of potions on the shelf.
The Apothecary will still operate while you are offline.
